business_problem: Over the past decade, as Nykaa evolved from an exclusively beauty and personal care e-commerce platform to encompass various verticals, including grooming for men, fashion, eB2B and expanding its footprint internationally, data challenges arose. The company needed a team of 2-4 staff up to 3-4 weeks to generate the relevant business reports.
solution_summary: Find out how the Indian omnichannel retailer of beauty, fashion, and wellness brands scaled using AWS to generate business insights and achieve strategic growth through increased scalability and cost savings. In 2012, Nykaa embarked on a journey to reshape India's retail landscape as one of the country's first beauty e-commerce platforms. Over the last decade, Nykaa expanded its product offerings by introducing two platforms–Nykaa Fashion and Superstore by Nykaa. Today, through its websites, mobile apps, and a network of over 165 physical stores countrywide, Nykaa retails diverse products encompassing beauty, fashion, and wellness. With an extensive repertoire today of over 6000 brands, Nykaa serves over 40 million active users monthly. Recognizing the need for robust data aggregation and analysis, Nykaa began building a data lake with common ingestion, governance, and query layers using Amazon Web Services (AWS).

solution_components.name: AWS Lake Formation
solution_components.role: Applies governance and access controls across the customer data lake.

solution_components.name: Amazon Redshift
solution_components.role: Stores analytical data and powers warehouse-style querying for reporting or ML features.

solution_components.name: Amazon Athena
solution_components.role: Queries data in place for analytics without managed servers.

data_flow: Source data enters the Nykaa workflow through its application services, stored or indexed in Amazon Redshift, and delivered through Amazon Athena.
business_outcome: The company aims to incorporate more data sources in future, including real-time feeds, to generate even more targeted insights and create personalized customer experiences. With the consolidated data lake, Nykaa's vision extends to integrating machine learning capabilities. Key reported metrics include reduction in core software expenses for cost-optimized data engineering infrastructure during proof of concept 30%; increase in daily data refreshes, which facilitates more accurate and timely reporting 48x; 48x.
metrics: reduction in core software expenses for cost-optimized data engineering infrastructure during proof of concept 30%
increase in daily data refreshes, which facilitates more accurate and timely reporting 48x
After 3-4 weeks, Nykaa observed a 30 percent reduction in its core software expenses due to Amazon EMR’s elastic scaling capabilities and pay-as-you-go pricing model.
As a cornerstone of its “One Nykaa, One Data” initiative, the data lake can now consolidate over 400 terabytes of unarchived data from various sources into a single data lake.
With autoscaling built into Amazon EMR, the company can now automatically scale its data processing workloads, facilitating up to 10,000 data ingestion jobs.
Consequently, Nykaa’s business analytics team requires only 5 hours to generate a new business report from what took up to 2 weeks.
Today, the team has scaled the data processing platform to generate over 1,500 sets of customer data.
architecture_clues: Finally, Nykaa uses Amazon Redshift and Amazon Athena , a serverless analytics service, to analyze petabyte-scale data at the query layer.
